title: Proto TD Level
description: TD level JSON. Primary source of truth per HR-TD-4. Output of stage-pcg-wfc is one valid instance.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version. Bump on breaking changes (HR-TD-4).

levelId.description: Stable level identifier. Used in asset path Assets/Proto/Data/TD/Levels/<levelId>.json (HR-TD-10).

gridSize.description: Grid width and height in cells. Q7 defaults: 20 / 40 / 80.

cellSize.description: World units per cell. Fixed at 1m for Proto.

seed.description: Xorshift64 seed used for generation. Hex string with 0x prefix (HR-TD-2).

tiles.description: 2D tile grid. tiles[y][x] = tileId. Length MUST be gridSize.h, each row length MUST be gridSize.w.

paths.description: Enemy paths (Q6 lanes). Each path is a polyline of grid-cell waypoints from spawn edge to coreBase.

powerSources.description: Power source cell positions. At least 1 required.

coreBase.description: Core base cell position. All enemy paths must terminate here.

linkBudget.description: Total link-distance budget for placing hubs (HR-TD-6).

meta.description: Optional generator metadata for reproducibility and debugging. Not required for gameplay.
